script: You can see a place where stars are being born with just your eyes. It is the Orion Nebula, a fuzzy patch below the three belt stars of Orion. It is about 1,300 light-years away. Inside, thousands of young stars are forming from glowing gas. It is the closest large star-forming region to Earth. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
